## Status String → Integer Mapping
The status string (`malopStatus`) is read from `malop.get("status")`, or if empty, from `malop.get("simpleValues").get("managementStatus").get("values")[0]` (defaulting to `"UNREAD"`).

| Status String | Integer |
|---|---|
| `"Remediated"` or `"TODO"` | **1** |
| `"Closed"` or `"RESOLVED"` | **2** |
| anything else | **0** |

## Key Names Read Per Field

| Field | Nested format key | Flat format key |
|---|---|---|
| **guidString** | `guidString`, else `guid` | (same fallback chain) |
| **creation time** | `simpleValues.creationTime.values[0]` | `creationTime` |
| **update time** | `simpleValues.malopLastUpdateTime.values[0]` | `lastUpdateTime` |
| **detection type** | `simpleValues.detectionType.values[0]` | `malopDetectionType` |
| **edr flag** | `simpleValues` (presence) | `isEdr` or `edr` |
| **root cause element name** | `elementValues.primaryRootCauseElements.elementValues[0].name` | `primaryRootCauseName` |
| **root cause element type** | `elementValues.primaryRootCauseElements.elementValues[0].elementType` | `rootCauseElementType` |

## How Nested vs Flat Is Distinguished

- **Creation/update time**: uses walrus check `if simple_values := malop.get("simpleValues")` — if `simpleValues` exists, use nested; else flat.
- **Root cause name/type**: uses `if element_values := malop.get("elementValues")` — if present, read nested `primaryRootCauseElements`; else use flat keys.
- **Detection type**: tries `malop.get("malopDetectionType")` first (flat); if falsy, falls back to nested `simpleValues.detectionType`.
- **EDR flag** (`isEdr`): true if any of `malop.get("isEdr")`, `malop.get("edr")`, or `malop.get("simpleValues")` is truthy — the presence of `simpleValues` itself implies EDR.
